Phoenix, Arizona | former_school(s)= | awards = }} '''Jerryd Bayless''' (born [[August 20]], [[1988]] in [[Phoenix, Arizona]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[basketball]] player. He played a year of [[college basketball]] for the [[Arizona Wildcats]]. ==College years== In his freshman season, he averaged a team-high of 19.7 points per game while picking up an average of 2.7 [[Rebound (basketball)|rebounds]] and 4.0 [[Assist (basketball)|assists]].{{cite web|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/teams/stats?teamId=12&year=2008|title=Arizona Wildcats Statistics - 2007-08|publisher=ESPN|accessdate=2008-04-05}} His team finished the season with an 18–13 record (8–10 in the [[Pac-10]]), including a loss to [[2007-08 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|West Virginia]] in the first round of the [[2008 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|NCAA tournament]].{{cite web|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/teams/schedule?teamId=12&year=2008|title=Arizona Wildcats Schedule - 2007-08|publisher=ESPN|accessdate=2008-04-05}} After the season, he decided to declare early for the [[2008 NBA Draft]].{{cite news|url=http://www.sportsnetwork.com/default.asp?c=sportsnetwork&page=cbask/news/AEN4142998.htm|title=Bayless declares eligibility for NBA Draft|publisher=''The Sports Network''|accessdate=2008-04-05|date=2008-04-05}} [[ESPN]]'s [[Chad Ford]] predicted that Bayless would be selected fifth in the draft{{cite web|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/lottery2008/mockdraft|title=NBA Lottery Mock Draft|publisher=ESPN|accessdate=2008-04-05}}, while NBAdraft.net and DraftExpress predict that he will be selected fourth.{{cite web|url=http://jerryd-bayless-nba.blogspot.com/2008/06/jerryd-bayless-nba-draft.html|title=Jerryd Bayless in the NBA draft}} ==Honors and awards== ===High school=== *Named to the 2007 USA Basketball Junior National Select Team *Named to the 2006 USA Men's U18 National Team which went on to win a bronze medal in the [[FIBA World Championship]]. *Four-time [[Arizona Republic]] All-Arizona team selection (2004, 2005, 2006 and 2007). *Ranked as the No. 9 overall recruit and the No. 2 shooting guard by both [[Scout.com]]{{cite web|url=http://scouthoops.scout.com/a.z?s=75&p=8&c=1&nid=1264475|title=Jerryd Bayless|publisher=Scout.com|accessdate=2008-04-05}} and [[Rivals.com]].{{cite web|url=http://rivalshoops.rivals.com/viewprospect.asp?pr_key=28610&Sport=2|title=Jerryd Bayless|publisher=Rivals.com|accessdate=2008-04-05}} Source:{{cite web|url=http://www.arizonaathletics.com/m-basketball/playerbio.aspx?id=41306|title=Jerryd Bayless|publisher=Arizona Wildcats|accessdate=2008-04-05}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Bayless, Jerryd}} [[Category:1988 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American basketball players]] [[Category:Arizona Wildcats men's basketball players]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:People from Phoenix, Arizona]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] {{1980s-US-basketball-bio-stub}}
